scientific_integrity: All-parameter proof supplied. Standalone graph-adjacency enumeration corroborates parameters 3 through 10. Publication priority and the proof have not undergone independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary defensive alliances only, not strong or global dominating alliances.
Conclusions restricted to crown graphs with n >= 3.
Residual risk of an unindexed equivalent claim.
Finite experiments are not infinite proofs.
title: Crown-graph defensive alliances: exact local/global minimal censuses and a binomial-square parity law
